falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A volatility-regime break contradicts the indeterminate, contained-stress read implied by blowoff score 39 and signal HOLD.

falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August-2024 bottom analog or the non-blowoff reading that supports staying UNKNOWN/HOLD would be broken.
